# uptimeify_user (Data Source)

Look up one login of the organization by email (case-insensitive), e.g. for team members and rotations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User id, as `user_id` in IM resources.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `role` (String) `admin`, `editor`, `readonly` or `responder`. IM accepts admin, editor and responder.
